Members

(module scope)

One glyph of a staggered draw — ci is the global character index used to compute the per-char animation delay, value the printable character.

(module scope)

A node of the draw-text token tree — type discriminates text vs markup chunks; chars holds the staggered glyphs, tag/attrStr/inner carry parsed markup, chunks nests child tokens so recursion walks one uniform shape.

(module scope)

A setTimeout handle that may be Node's Timeout — unref exists only in Node, so the intersection type keeps .unref?.() callable in workers/tests.
